member.summary: List of symbologies you want to detect. By default, all possible symbologies included. You can narrow down the list by setting this to your own list of symbologies.

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.DelayBetweenContinuousScans
member.summary: Delay in milliseconds. 1 second by default. If you are in continuous scanning mode use this to set delay between consecutive scans.

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.DelayBetweenAnalyzingFrames
member.summary: Delay in milliseconds. 150ms by default. Use this to tune delay between frame analysis

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.DelayBeforeAnalyzingFrames
member.summary: Delay in milliseconds. 300ms by default. Use this to tune the delay before first frame will be analyzed.

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.CustomOverlayFactory
member.summary: Factory for creating custom scanner overlay. The library will call it for view creation passing its context (Activity or ViewController) as argument for memory leaks prevention The returning object must be an Android.Views.View or UIKit.UIView In addition if you want to create custom overlay with animations your overlay class must implement IActiveScannerOverlay interface provided by this library otherwise it will not receive updates from scan engine

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.DelayBeforeScannerClose
member.summary: Delay before scanner closure after successful scan (in milliseconds)
member.remarks: ⚠️ WARNING: Minimal acceptable value is 300 ms. If you try to set value below 300ms it will be automatically set to 300ms to ensure there will be no problems with animations.

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.UseAutoClose
member.summary:
Set if you want to enable automatic scanner closure.
This works only in single scan mode. Continuous scan mode does not use this feature.

member.name: P:BarcodeScanner.Models.BarcodeScanningOptions.AutoCloseDelaySeconds
member.summary:
Delay (in seconds) before scanner will auto close. 15 seconds by default.
If you set UseAutoClose = true and AutoCloseDelaySeconds = 0 automatic closure will not work.
